segments.an4.35:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā rājagahe viharati veḷuvane kalandakanivāpe.
segments.an4.35:1.2: Atha kho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmatto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
segments.an4.35:1.3: Sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sāraṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho vassakāro brāhmaṇo magadhamahāmatto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.an4.35:2.1: “Catūhi kho mayaṃ, bho gotama, dhammehi samannāgataṃ mahāpaññaṃ mahāpurisaṃ paññāpema.
segments.an4.35:2.3: Idha, bho gotama, bahussuto hoti tassa tasseva sutajātassa tassa tasseva kho pana bhāsitassa atthaṃ jānāti –
segments.an4.35:2.4: ‘ayaṃ imassa bhāsitassa attho, ayaṃ imassa bhāsitassa attho’ti.
segments.an4.35:2.5: Satimā kho pana hoti cirakatampi cirabhāsitampi saritā anussaritā yāni kho pana tāni gahaṭṭhakāni kiṃkaraṇīyāni, tattha dakkho hoti analaso, tatrupāyāya vīmaṃsāya samannāgato alaṃ kātuṃ alaṃ saṃvidhātuṃ.
segments.an4.35:2.7: Imehi kho mayaṃ, bho gotama, catūhi dhammehi samannāgataṃ mahāpaññaṃ mahāpurisaṃ paññāpema.
segments.an4.35:2.8: Sace me [sace pana me (sī. ka.), sace me pana (pī.)], bho gotama, anumoditabbaṃ anumodatu me bhavaṃ gotamo;
segments.an4.35:2.9: sace pana me, bho gotama, paṭikkositabbaṃ paṭikkosatu me bhavaṃ gotamo”ti.
segments.an4.35:3.1: “Neva kho tyāhaṃ, brāhmaṇa, anumodāmi na paṭikkosāmi.
segments.an4.35:3.2: Catūhi kho ahaṃ, brāhmaṇa, dhammehi samannāgataṃ mahāpaññaṃ mahāpurisaṃ paññāpemi.
segments.an4.35:3.4: Idha, brāhmaṇa, bahujanahitāya paṭipanno hoti bahujanasukhāya;
segments.an4.35:3.5: bahussa janatā ariye ñāye patiṭṭhāpitā, yadidaṃ kalyāṇadhammatā kusaladhammatā.
segments.an4.35:3.6: So yaṃ vitakkaṃ ākaṅkhati vitakketuṃ taṃ vitakkaṃ vitakketi, yaṃ vitakkaṃ nākaṅkhati vitakketuṃ na taṃ vitakkaṃ vitakketi;
segments.an4.35:3.7: yaṃ saṅkappaṃ ākaṅkhati saṅkappetuṃ taṃ saṅkappaṃ saṅkappeti, yaṃ saṅkappaṃ nākaṅkhati saṅkappetuṃ na taṃ saṅkappaṃ saṅkappeti.
segments.an4.35:3.9: Catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
segments.an4.35:3.10: Āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
segments.an4.35:3.11: Neva kho tyāhaṃ, brāhmaṇa, anumodāmi na pana paṭikkosāmi.
segments.an4.35:3.12: Imehi kho ahaṃ, brāhmaṇa, catūhi dhammehi samannāgataṃ mahāpaññaṃ mahāpurisaṃ paññāpemī”ti.
segments.an4.35:4.3: Imehi ca mayaṃ, bho gotama, catūhi dhammehi samannāgataṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ dhārema;
segments.an4.35:4.5: bahu te [bahussa (syā. kaṃ. ka.)] janatā ariye ñāye patiṭṭhāpitā, yadidaṃ kalyāṇadhammatā kusaladhammatā.
segments.an4.35:4.6: Bhavañhi gotamo yaṃ vitakkaṃ ākaṅkhati vitakketuṃ taṃ vitakkaṃ vitakketi, yaṃ vitakkaṃ nākaṅkhati vitakketuṃ na taṃ vitakkaṃ vitakketi, yaṃ saṅkappaṃ ākaṅkhati saṅkappetuṃ taṃ saṅkappaṃ saṅkappeti, yaṃ saṅkappaṃ nākaṅkhati saṅkappetuṃ na taṃ saṅkappaṃ saṅkappeti.
segments.an4.35:4.8: Bhavañhi gotamo catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
segments.an4.35:4.9: Bhavañhi gotamo āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī”ti.
segments.an4.35:5.1: “Addhā kho tyāhaṃ, brāhmaṇa, āsajja upanīya vācā bhāsitā.
segments.an4.35:5.4: bahu me [bahussa (syā. kaṃ. ka.)] janatā ariye ñāye patiṭṭhāpitā, yadidaṃ kalyāṇadhammatā kusaladhammatā.
segments.an4.35:5.5: Ahañhi, brāhmaṇa, yaṃ vitakkaṃ ākaṅkhāmi vitakketuṃ taṃ vitakkaṃ vitakkemi, yaṃ vitakkaṃ nākaṅkhāmi vitakketuṃ na taṃ vitakkaṃ vitakkemi, yaṃ saṅkappaṃ ākaṅkhāmi saṅkappetuṃ taṃ saṅkappaṃ saṅkappemi, yaṃ saṅkappaṃ nākaṅkhāmi saṅkappetuṃ na taṃ saṅkappaṃ saṅkappemi.
segments.an4.35:5.7: Ahañhi, brāhmaṇa, catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhī.
segments.an4.35:5.8: Ahañhi, brāhmaṇa, āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharāmī’”ti.
segments.an4.35:6.5: Yaṃ ve disvā ca sutvā ca, pasīdanti bahū janā [pasīdati bahujjano (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)].
segments.an4.35:7.3: Buddho antimasārīro [antimadhārito (ka.)],“(mahāpañño)[() syā. potthake natthi] mahāpurisoti vuccatī”ti.

lines: Pañcame anussaritāti anugantvā saritā, aparāparaṃ sarituṃ samatthoti attho.
Tatrupāyāyāti “imasmiṃ kāle imaṃ nāma kattabban”ti evaṃ tattha tattha upāyabhūtāya paññāya samannāgato.
Neva kho tyāhanti neva kho te ahaṃ.
Lokiyattā nābhinandati, lokiyaṃ atthaṃ gahetvā ṭhitattā nappaṭikkosati.
Na taṃ vitakkaṃ vitakketīti kāmavitakkādīsu ekampi na vitakketi.
Ahañhi brāhmaṇātiādīsu paṭhamanayena khīṇāsavassa sīlañceva bāhusaccañca kathitaṃ, dutiyatatiyehi khīṇāsavassa kiriyavitakkāni ceva kiriyajjhānāni ca, catutthena khīṇāsavabhāvo kathitoti veditabbo.
Disvā ca sutvā cāti ñāṇeneva passitvā ca suṇitvā ca.
Pañcame ariye ñāyeti saṃkilesato ārakattā ariye niddose parisuddhe niyyānikadhammabhāvato ñāye kāraṇeti attho.
Ñāyati nicchayena kamati nibbānaṃ, taṃ vā ñāyati paṭivijjhīyati etenātī ñāyo, ariyamaggo.
So eva ca sampāpakahetubhāvato kāraṇanti vuccati.
Idha pana saha vipassanāya ariyamaggo adhippetoti āha “sahavipassanake magge”ti.
